################ lope --help
usage: lope [-h]
            {negotiate,execute,implement,audit,ask,review,vote,compare,pipe,team,deliberate,memory,gate,check,status,jobs,configure,install,update,upgrade,version,docs,flow}
            ...

Autonomous sprint runner with multi-CLI validator ensemble. Any AI CLI implements, any AI CLI
validates. Supports 15 built-in CLIs (claude, opencode, gemini, codex, vibe, aider, ollama, goose,
interpreter, llama-cpp, gh-copilot, amazon-q, pi, qwen, agy) plus infinite custom providers via
JSON. Three domains: engineering, business, research. Caveman mode (LOPE_CAVEMAN env var)
compresses validator prompts 50-65%.

positional arguments:
  {negotiate,execute,implement,audit,ask,review,vote,compare,pipe,team,deliberate,memory,gate,check,status,jobs,configure,install,update,upgrade,version,docs,flow}
    negotiate           Draft a sprint doc via multi-round validation
    execute             Run sprint phases with validator-in-the-loop
    implement           Run a sprint with zero-human swarm orchestration
    audit               Generate scorecard from sprint results
    ask                 Ask every validator the same question, collect N answers
    review              Fan out a file review to every validator, collect N critiques
    vote                Each validator picks one option; tally + print winner
    compare             Each validator picks the better of two files against explicit criteria
    pipe                Read stdin as the prompt, fan out to validators, print answers
    team                Manage your validator team: list / add / remove / test teammates
    deliberate          Run a council deliberation (ADR/PRD/RFC/build-vs-buy/migration/incident)
    memory              Query and manage the persistent Lope finding memory
    gate                Save or compare objective evidence gate baselines
    check               Run objective evidence gates without a baseline
    status              Show available validators and config
    jobs                Inspect and manage Lope-owned runs
    configure           Interactive validator picker
    install             Install lope skills into CLI hosts
    update              Update Lope itself, then refresh installed host skills
    upgrade             Legacy alias for `lope update`
    version             Show version
    docs                Print the complete lope reference to stdout
    flow                Run declarative graph workflows (autonomous multi-agent, bounded)

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

Config: ~/.lope/config.json (set LOPE_HOME to override). Custom providers: add to 'providers'
array in config. Caveman mode: LOPE_CAVEMAN=full|lite|off. Docs: https://github.com/traylinx/lope

################ lope negotiate --help
usage: lope negotiate [-h] [--out OUT] [--max-rounds MAX_ROUNDS] [--context CONTEXT]
                      [--context-file CONTEXT_FILE] [--domain {engineering,business,research}]
                      [--validators VALIDATORS] [--primary PRIMARY] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                      [--respect-provider-timeout]
                      [--run-timeout RUN_TIMEOUT | --allow-unbounded-run] [--max-calls MAX_CALLS]
                      [--max-chunks MAX_CHUNKS] [--request-policy {auto,direct,chunk}]
                      [--parallel | --sequential] [--brain-context QUERY]
                      [--brain-budget BRAIN_BUDGET] [--brain-log]
                      goal

positional arguments:
  goal                  Sprint goal description

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --out OUT             Output path for sprint doc
  --max-rounds MAX_ROUNDS
  --context CONTEXT     Additional context
  --context-file CONTEXT_FILE
                        Read additional context from a file instead of stuffing a huge string into
                        argv
  --domain {engineering,business,research}
                        Domain: engineering (default), business, or research
  --validators VALIDATORS
                        Comma-separated validator list, e.g. opencode,gemini
  --primary PRIMARY     Name of the primary validator (must be in --validators)
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Per-validator timeout in seconds
  --respect-provider-timeout
                        Let a provider's configured timeout outrank --timeout (default: the
                        stricter of the two wins)
  --run-timeout RUN_TIMEOUT
                        Hard whole-command deadline in seconds
  --allow-unbounded-run
                        Unsafe: remove only the wall deadline; call/chunk/byte limits remain
  --max-calls MAX_CALLS
                        Maximum external model/provider calls for this run
  --max-chunks MAX_CHUNKS
                        Maximum planned request chunks (default: 32)
  --request-policy {auto,direct,chunk}
                        Oversize request policy (default: auto)
  --parallel            Run validators in parallel
  --sequential          Run all validators sequentially, then synthesize the ensemble vote
  --brain-context QUERY
                        Pull Makakoo Brain context for QUERY and prepend to validator prompts
  --brain-budget BRAIN_BUDGET
                        Approximate token budget for brain context (default: 1200)
  --brain-log           Append a bullet to today's Makakoo Brain journal after the run

################ lope execute --help
usage: lope execute [-h] [--phase PHASE] [--manual] [--gates] [--gate-config GATE_CONFIG]
                    [--trust] [--validators VALIDATORS] [--primary PRIMARY] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                    [--respect-provider-timeout]
                    [--run-timeout RUN_TIMEOUT | --allow-unbounded-run] [--max-calls MAX_CALLS]

                    [--parallel | --sequential]

positional arguments:
  sprint_doc            Path to sprint doc markdown

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --phase PHASE         Run specific phase only
  --manual              Human-in-the-loop mode: wait for Enter between phases (legacy pre-v0.4.0
                        behavior). Default is autonomous via primary validator's generate()
                        method.
  --gates               Run objective evidence gates before/after each phase (opt-in)
  --gate-config GATE_CONFIG
                        Path to .lope/rules.json gate config
  --trust               Trust this repo's gate commands and run them without prompting (or set
                        LOPE_TRUST_GATES=1)
  --validators VALIDATORS
                        Comma-separated validator list, e.g. opencode,gemini
  --primary PRIMARY     Name of the primary validator (must be in --validators)
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Per-validator timeout in seconds
  --respect-provider-timeout
                        Let a provider's configured timeout outrank --timeout (default: the
                        stricter of the two wins)
  --run-timeout RUN_TIMEOUT
                        Hard whole-command deadline in seconds
  --allow-unbounded-run
                        Unsafe: remove only the wall deadline; call/chunk/byte limits remain
  --max-calls MAX_CALLS
                        Maximum external model/provider calls for this run
  --max-chunks MAX_CHUNKS
                        Maximum planned request chunks (default: 32)
  --request-policy {auto,direct,chunk}
                        Oversize request policy (default: auto)
  --parallel            Run validators in parallel
  --sequential          Run all validators sequentially, then synthesize the ensemble vote

################ lope review --help
usage: lope review [-h] [--focus FOCUS] [--json] [--consensus] [--structured]
                   [--min-consensus MIN_CONSENSUS] [--similarity SIMILARITY]
                   [--format {text,json,markdown,markdown-pr,sarif}] [--output OUTPUT]
                   [--include-raw] [--remember] [--divide {files,hunks}] [--roles ROLES]
                   [--validators VALIDATORS] [--primary PRIMARY] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                   [--respect-provider-timeout]
                   [--run-timeout RUN_TIMEOUT | --allow-unbounded-run] [--max-calls MAX_CALLS]
                   [--max-chunks MAX_CHUNKS] [--request-policy {auto,direct,chunk}]
                   [--parallel | --sequential] [--synth] [--anonymous] [--brain-context QUERY]
                   [--brain-budget BRAIN_BUDGET] [--brain-log]
                   file

positional arguments:
  file                  Path to the file to review

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --focus FOCUS         Optional focus area (e.g. 'security', 'perf', 'tests'; 'over-engineering',
                        'minimality', 'lazy-build' expand to a minimality rubric)
  --json                Emit machine-readable JSON instead of human sections
  --consensus           Merge, dedupe, and consensus-rank findings (v0.7)
  --structured          Alias for --consensus
  --min-consensus MIN_CONSENSUS
                        Drop findings with consensus_score below this threshold (default: 0.0)
  --similarity SIMILARITY
                        Cross-validator dedup similarity threshold (default: 0.85)
  --format {text,json,markdown,markdown-pr,sarif}
                        Output format for consensus mode (default: text)
  --output OUTPUT, -o OUTPUT
                        Write output report directly to file path
  --include-raw         Append raw per-validator responses to consensus output
  --remember            Store consensus findings in the persistent Lope memory (v0.7)
  --divide {files,hunks}
                        Divide the target before review: walk a directory of files or split a
                        unified-diff into hunks
  --roles ROLES         Comma-separated role lenses (e.g. 'security,performance,tests'); round-
                        robin-assigned to validators
  --validators VALIDATORS
                        Comma-separated validator list, e.g. opencode,gemini
  --primary PRIMARY     Name of the primary validator (must be in --validators)
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Per-validator timeout in seconds
  --respect-provider-timeout
                        Let a provider's configured timeout outrank --timeout (default: the
                        stricter of the two wins)
  --run-timeout RUN_TIMEOUT
                        Hard whole-command deadline in seconds
  --allow-unbounded-run
                        Unsafe: remove only the wall deadline; call/chunk/byte limits remain
  --max-calls MAX_CALLS
                        Maximum external model/provider calls for this run
  --max-chunks MAX_CHUNKS
                        Maximum planned request chunks (default: 32)
  --request-policy {auto,direct,chunk}
                        Oversize request policy (default: auto)
  --parallel            Run validators in parallel
  --sequential          Run all validators sequentially, then synthesize the ensemble vote
  --synth               Run a synthesis pass on the fan-out (executive summary)
  --anonymous           Strip validator names from synthesis input (Response A/B/C labels)
  --brain-context QUERY
                        Pull Makakoo Brain context for QUERY and prepend to validator prompts
  --brain-budget BRAIN_BUDGET
                        Approximate token budget for brain context (default: 1200)
  --brain-log           Append a bullet to today's Makakoo Brain journal after the run

################ lope team --help
usage: lope team [-h] {list,enable,disable,add,remove,test,health} ...

positional arguments:
  {list,enable,disable,add,remove,test,health}
    list                Show current team members (default if no subcommand)
    enable              Enable existing built-in or saved custom teammates without redefining them
    disable             Disable active teammates without deleting custom provider config
    add                 Add a new teammate. Provide --cmd (subprocess) OR --url (HTTP). Adds to
                        providers AND enables in validators unless --disabled.
    remove              Remove a teammate from providers + validators + primary
    test                Smoke-test one teammate with a prompt (defaults to 'Say hello in one
                        word.')
    health              Run a preflight health check on every active validator

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

################ lope team add --help
usage: lope team add [-h] [--cmd CMD] [--stdin] [--url URL] [--model MODEL] [--key-env KEY_ENV]
                     [--key-header KEY_HEADER] [--key-prefix KEY_PREFIX]
                     [--response-path RESPONSE_PATH] [--body-json BODY_JSON]
                     [--from-curl FROM_CURL] [--wrap WRAP] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                     [--max-tokens MAX_TOKENS] [--primary] [--disabled] [--force]
                     name

positional arguments:
  name                  Teammate name (e.g. openclaw, my-ollama, mistral-pod)

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --cmd CMD             Subprocess command, e.g. "openclaw chat --prompt {prompt}". Tokens split
                        via shlex. If {prompt} is missing, it's appended.
  --stdin               Pipe prompt via stdin instead of argv substitution
  --url URL             HTTP endpoint URL (implies HTTP type). OpenAI-compatible shape by default.
  --model MODEL         Model name for HTTP body (required unless --body-json used)
  --key-env KEY_ENV     Env var name holding the API key (e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY). Stored as ${VAR}
                        in headers — expanded at call time, not saved in plaintext.
  --key-header KEY_HEADER
                        Auth header name (default: Authorization)
  --key-prefix KEY_PREFIX
                        Auth token prefix (default: 'Bearer '). Use '' for raw keys.
  --response-path RESPONSE_PATH
                        JSON dot-path to extract answer (default: choices.0.message.content)
  --body-json BODY_JSON
                        Raw JSON body override — replaces OpenAI-compatible shape entirely
  --from-curl FROM_CURL
                        Paste an entire curl command (quoted). Auto-extracts URL, headers, body,
                        and response_path; auto-injects {prompt} into the user-content field.
                        Credential-bearing headers must use ${VAR}, or pass --key-env so lope
                        swaps the literal for you.
  --wrap WRAP           Prompt wrapper template, e.g. 'Answer tersely: {prompt}'
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Per-call timeout override in seconds
  --max-tokens MAX_TOKENS
                        Optional provider response-token cap
  --primary             Make this the primary validator (used by execute() for implementation)
  --disabled            Save provider config but don't add to active validators list
  --force               Overwrite an existing provider with the same name

################ lope deliberate --help
usage: lope deliberate [-h] [--depth {quick,standard,deep}] [--out OUT] [--no-anonymize]
                       [--minority-report] [--human-questions {never,blocking,always}] [--json]
                       [--validators VALIDATORS] [--primary PRIMARY] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                       [--respect-provider-timeout]
                       [--run-timeout RUN_TIMEOUT | --allow-unbounded-run] [--max-calls MAX_CALLS]
                       [--max-chunks MAX_CHUNKS] [--request-policy {auto,direct,chunk}]
                       [--parallel | --sequential] [--brain-context QUERY]
                       [--brain-budget BRAIN_BUDGET] [--brain-log]
                       {adr,prd,rfc,build-vs-buy,migration-plan,incident-review} scenario

positional arguments:
  {adr,prd,rfc,build-vs-buy,migration-plan,incident-review}
                        Deliberation template
  scenario              Path to scenario file (or '-' for stdin)

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --depth {quick,standard,deep}
                        Council depth (default: standard)
  --out OUT             Output directory (default: lope-runs/<timestamp>-<template>/)
  --no-anonymize        Disable anonymized critique (validator names will leak)
  --minority-report     Force minority report output even when council is unanimous (default:
                        always emitted)
  --human-questions {never,blocking,always}
                        When to surface clarifying questions to the human (default: never)
  --json                Emit a JSON summary instead of human-readable text
  --validators VALIDATORS
                        Comma-separated validator list, e.g. opencode,gemini
  --primary PRIMARY     Name of the primary validator (must be in --validators)
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Per-validator timeout in seconds
  --respect-provider-timeout
                        Let a provider's configured timeout outrank --timeout (default: the
                        stricter of the two wins)
  --run-timeout RUN_TIMEOUT
                        Hard whole-command deadline in seconds
  --allow-unbounded-run
                        Unsafe: remove only the wall deadline; call/chunk/byte limits remain
  --max-calls MAX_CALLS
                        Maximum external model/provider calls for this run
  --max-chunks MAX_CHUNKS
                        Maximum planned request chunks (default: 32)
  --request-policy {auto,direct,chunk}
                        Oversize request policy (default: auto)
  --parallel            Run validators in parallel
  --sequential          Run all validators sequentially, then synthesize the ensemble vote
  --brain-context QUERY
                        Pull Makakoo Brain context for QUERY and prepend to validator prompts
  --brain-budget BRAIN_BUDGET
                        Approximate token budget for brain context (default: 1200)
  --brain-log           Append a bullet to today's Makakoo Brain journal after the run

################ lope memory --help
usage: lope memory [-h] {stats,search,file,hotspots,forget,gates} ...

positional arguments:
  {stats,search,file,hotspots,forget,gates}
    stats               Show aggregate memory statistics
    search              LIKE-search stored findings by message
    file                Show stored findings for a specific file
    hotspots            Files with the most stored findings recently
    forget              Remove findings by --hash or --file
    gates               Show recent objective gate sessions

  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

################ lope flow --help
usage: lope flow [-h] {run,validate,lint,render,init,list} ...

positional arguments:
  {run,validate,lint,render,init,list}
    run                 Run a .dot workflow
    validate (lint)     Statically check a workflow is runnable + bounded
    render              Render a workflow to SVG/PNG (uses system graphviz)
    init                Write a starter workflow template
    list                List bundled flow templates

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

################ lope flow run --help
usage: lope flow run [-h] [--task TASK] [--cwd CWD] [--out OUT]
                     [--max-node-visits MAX_NODE_VISITS] [--no-journal] [--dry-run]
                     [--validators VALIDATORS] [--primary PRIMARY] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                     [--respect-provider-timeout]
                     [--run-timeout RUN_TIMEOUT | --allow-unbounded-run] [--max-calls MAX_CALLS]
                     [--max-chunks MAX_CHUNKS] [--request-policy {auto,direct,chunk}]
                     [--parallel | --sequential]
                     workflow

positional arguments:
  workflow              Path to the .dot workflow file

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --task TASK           The goal, substituted for $task in the graph
  --cwd CWD             Working directory for agent/script nodes (default: cwd)
  --out OUT             Write trace.jsonl + report.md to this directory
  --max-node-visits MAX_NODE_VISITS
                        Global runaway cap (default: graph value or max(50, 8*nodes))
  --no-journal          Skip the Brain journal entry
  --dry-run             Validate and print the plan without executing
  --validators VALIDATORS
                        Comma-separated validator list, e.g. opencode,gemini
  --primary PRIMARY     Name of the primary validator (must be in --validators)
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Per-validator timeout in seconds
  --respect-provider-timeout
                        Let a provider's configured timeout outrank --timeout (default: the
                        stricter of the two wins)
  --run-timeout RUN_TIMEOUT
                        Hard whole-command deadline in seconds
  --allow-unbounded-run
                        Unsafe: remove only the wall deadline; call/chunk/byte limits remain
  --max-calls MAX_CALLS
                        Maximum external model/provider calls for this run
  --max-chunks MAX_CHUNKS
                        Maximum planned request chunks (default: 32)
  --request-policy {auto,direct,chunk}
                        Oversize request policy (default: auto)
  --parallel            Run validators in parallel
  --sequential          Run all validators sequentially, then synthesize the ensemble vote
